instruction: I need to set up my direct deposit for my on-campus job, where do I go?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal and navigate to Time & Leave Resources card and click Employee Dashboard and click Direct Deposit Information then click Add New Bank Account, enter your routing and account number and click submit.

instruction: How can I change the bank account where my paycheck goes?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal, find Time & Leave Resources card, select Employee Dashboard, click Direct Deposit Information, select the existing account to edit or delete it, then Add New Bank Account with new details and submit.

instruction: Where do I see my past pay stubs on the msu portal?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal, go to Time & Leave Resources card, click Employee Dashboard, click on Earnings, and you will see a list of Pay Dates, click on a specific date to view the pay stub details.

instruction: I started working today, how do I log my hours?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal and navigate to Time & Leave Resources card and click Employee Dashboard and click Enter Time, select your current job position, click the box under the current date, enter hours worked, and click Save.

instruction: How do I submit my timesheet at the end of the pay period?

instruction: I made a mistake on my timesheet and already saved it, how to fix?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal, go to Employee Dashboard via Time & Leave Resources card, click Enter Time, click on the specific day with the error, change the hours in the box, and click Save again to update it before submitting.

instruction: Where can I see my W2 tax forms as a student employee?
response: Navigate to the Time & Leave Resources card on Missouri State University portal, click Employee Dashboard, expand the Taxes menu, and click W-2 Wage and Tax Statements to view or print your forms.

instruction: I need to see a doctor at Magers, how do I book it?

instruction: How do I get my flu shot at MSU?

instruction: Do I have to pay for Microsoft Word as a student?
response: No, MSU student can use Microsoft office products such as word, excel, powerpoint for free. You can download Office 365 on up to 5 devices using your missouri state university email credentials.

instruction: How much OneDrive storage do I get as an MSU student?
response: As part of the Microsoft office ecosystem benefits, MSU students typically get 1TB of cloud storage on OneDrive for storing academic files and documents.

instruction: Can I keep my MSU Microsoft Office after I graduate?
response: No, the Microsoft office ecosystem benefits generally expire shortly after you are no longer an active student, employee, or retiree, so you should backup your data before leaving.

instruction: How do I install Office 365 on my laptop?
response: Login to your Missouri State University email (Outlook) via the web, click the app launcher (waffle icon) in top left, select Microsoft 365, and click the Install Apps button to download the office ecosystem installer.

instruction: I need to add a class for next semester.
response: Navigate to the Registration card on your student portal on Missouri State University portal, click Add or Drop Classes, select the term, enter the CRN or search for the class, select it and click Submit Changes.

instruction: How do I drop a class I don't want anymore?
response: Navigate to the Registration card on your student portal, click Add or Drop Classes, select the current term, find the class in your list, select 'Web Drop' from the action dropdown menu next to the class, and click Submit Changes.

instruction: How do I check when I can register for classes?
response: Navigate to the Registration card on your student portal on Missouri State University portal and click Registration Status Eligibility to see your specific registration time ticket and date.

instruction: What is the Trial Schedule Builder?
response: It is a tool found under the Registration card on the Missouri State University portal that allows you to input desired courses and breaks, and it generates possible schedule combinations for you to choose from before registering.

instruction: I have a hold preventing registration, how do I see what it is?
response: Navigate to the My Registration card on your student portal, click on Registration Status, and look for the section labeled 'Holds'. Click on the specific hold link to see which office placed it and how to resolve it.

instruction: I am graduating next semester, what is the first step?
response: Navigate to Graduation Checklist and Commencement Eligibility card on your student portal on Missouri State University portal and click Apply for Graduation to start the application process for your degree.

instruction: How do I know if my graduation application was accepted?
response: Check the Graduation Checklist and Commencement Eligibility card on your student portal, or check your student email for a confirmation from the Registrar or the msu committee regarding your application status.

instruction: My advisor said they left a note for me, where is it?
response: Navigate to the My Student Records card on your student portal on Missouri State University portal, click on Advising Notes, and you will see a history of notes left by your academic advisor.

instruction: Where do I see who my assigned advisor is?
response: Navigate to the My Student Records card on your student portal or the Registration Status page, and your primary academic advisor's name and contact link will be listed there.

instruction: How do I access the portal for international students?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal, search for the card International Services — Students, and click the link labeled International Student Portal to access SEVIS and immigration services.

instruction: How do I request a CPT I-20 for my internship?
response: First secure an internship offer, then Login to International Services — Students card via msu portal, click International Student Portal, navigate to F-1 Curricular Practical Training Request, complete the form, upload your offer letter, and submit for advisor approval.

instruction: I need to apply for CPT, do I use Handshake?
response: You use Handshake to find the job or report an experience if required by your department, but the actual CPT I-20 request must be done through the International Student Portal found on the International Services — Students card on the msu portal.

instruction: How do I check my program end date on the portal?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal, go to International Services — Students card, click International Student Portal, and view your Student Profile or current I-20 details to see the Program End Date listed in SEVIS.

instruction: I am an F1 student and want to work on campus, what is the rule?
response: You can work on campus up to 20 hours per week during the Spring and Fall semesters, and up to 40 hours per week during official school breaks and holidays. You must stop working if your program ends or you transfer.

instruction: I got an on-campus job offer, what paper work do I need?
response: Contact international service office via the portal to get a Social Security Support Letter request form, fill it, have your employer sign it, submit it back to international services to get the signed letter, then take that and your documents to the Social Security Administration office.

instruction: I am changing my major, what do I do as an international student?
response: Go to Missouri State University portal, International Services — Students card, click International Student Portal, go to Control Center, select Change/Add Major and/or Minor, upload proof of the new major (like a change of major form signed by advisor) and submit so your I-20 can be updated.

instruction: Can I take less than 12 credits as an undergrad international student?
response: Generally no, you must maintain 12 credits. If you have a valid medical or academic reason, you must login to the International Student Portal and submit a Reduced Course Load (RCL) Request form and get it approved BEFORE dropping below 12 hours.

instruction: How do I request a travel signature on my I-20?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal, navigate to International Services — Students card, click International Student Portal, look for Travel Signature Request under the request menu, fill the details and submit. You will be notified when the signed I-20 is ready.

instruction: I moved to a new apartment, how do I update my address for immigration?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal, go to International Student Portal, select Update Personal Information or Change of Address form, enter your new US address and submit within 10 days of moving to stay compliant with SEVIS.

instruction: How do I apply for OPT after graduation?
response: Login to the International Student Portal via the Missouri State University portal, navigate to F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT) Request, watch the mandatory OPT workshop video, complete the request form, upload required docs, and wait for the new I-20 recommendation before applying to USCIS.

instruction: Where do I find my degree audit?
response: Navigate to the Registration card or My Student Records card on your student portal on Missouri State University portal and click on Degree Works to view your progress towards graduation and remaining requirements.

instruction: I cannot login to my Employee Dashboard.
response: Ensure you are using your Missouri State University login credentials. If it fails, navigate to the Time & Leave Resources card, sometimes clearing cache helps, or contact the Computer Services Help Desk for account access issues.

instruction: How often do I need to fill my timesheet?
response: You should enter your hours daily or weekly in the Employee Dashboard under Time & Leave Resources to ensure accuracy, but you MUST submit the timesheet by the end of the pay period deadline set by payroll.

instruction: Can I work off campus on F1 visa?
response: Not without authorization. You need CPT (for internships before graduation) or OPT (usually post-graduation). Working off-campus without these authorizations accessed via the International Student Portal is a violation of your visa status.

instruction: I need verification that I am a student for a loan.
response: Navigate to the My Student Records card on Missouri State University portal and look for Enrollment Verification link, or contact the Office of the Registrar to request an official letter.

instruction: How do I add a minor to my degree?
response: Consult your advisor first, then if you are an international student, go to International Student Portal to file the Change/Add Major/Minor form. Domestic students usually process this via the Registrar or specific department forms found on the website.

instruction: Where is the Career Center on the portal?
response: Search for the Career Center card or Handshake link on the missouri state university portal to access job listings, resume reviews, and mock interview scheduling.

instruction: How do I pay my tuition bill?
response: Navigate to the Account Balance & Payments card on your student portal on missouri state university portal, click on the link to view or pay your bill, and follow the prompts to pay via e-check or credit card.

instruction: I need to withdraw from all my classes.
response: This is a serious action. Navigate to the Registration card, look for the withdraw options, but you should speak to your advisor and, if international, the International Services office immediately to avoid visa termination before doing this.

instruction: How do I get my 1098-T tax form?
response: Navigate to the Account Balance & Payments card or Tax Information section on the missouri state university portal to download your 1098-T Tuition Statement for tax purposes.

instruction: Can I install Microsoft Teams from the student portal?
response: Yes, as part of the Microsoft office ecosystem benefits, you can install Teams. Log into your University email online, click the app launcher, select Teams, or download the desktop app and sign in with your MSU account.

instruction: I have a hold for 'International Insurance', what do I do?
response: You must have health insurance. If you have your own compliant policy, submit a waiver request via the Magers Health portal or International Services. Otherwise, pay the premium so the hold is removed by the International office.

instruction: How to register for the payment plan for tuition?
response: Navigate to Account Balance & Payments card on Missouri State University portal, click the link for My Payment Plan, read the terms for the installment plan and click to enroll.

instruction: Where can I find the class final exam schedule?
response: Navigate to the Registration card on the Missouri State University portal, usually under the Class Schedule Search or Academic Calendar links, you can find the Final Exam Schedule for the current semester.

instruction: How to apply for a STEM OPT extension?
response: If you are on post-completion OPT and have a STEM degree, Login to International Student Portal via Missouri State University portal, find the STEM OPT Extension Request, upload your I-983 training plan and other docs, and submit for a new I-20 recommendation.

instruction: How do I report I lost my I-20?
response: Login to the International Student Portal on the Missouri State University portal, look for the Replacement I-20 Request form, select 'Lost/Stolen' as the reason, and submit to get a new one printed.

instruction: Can I edit my direct deposit info from home?
response: Yes, you can access the Employee Dashboard via the Time & Leave Resources card on the Missouri State University portal from anywhere to edit your Direct Deposit Information.

instruction: What happens if I don't submit my timesheet on time?
response: Your pay might be delayed. You should contact your supervisor immediately and they might need to submit a manual adjustment or you will be paid in the next cycle. Always try to submit via Employee Dashboard on time.

instruction: How do I use the Magers pharmacy?
response: You can walk in to Magers Health and Wellness center. Ensure your insurance info is on file at the reception or via the Magers Health portal card on the Missouri State University portal.

metadata.topic: Magers Health and wellness center portal

instruction: I need to certify my graduation for a job offer before the ceremony.
response: Navigate to Graduation Checklist on the Missouri State University student portal, or contact the Office of the Registrar to request a 'Letter of Completion' once all your requirements are met but the degree isn't conferred yet.

instruction: How do I check my leave balance (sick/vacation)?
response: Login to Missouri State University portal, go to Time & Leave Resources, click Employee Dashboard, and look for the Leave Balances section to see your accrued hours.

instruction: I am an international student, can I drop a class if I am failing?
response: Only if you stay above 12 credit hours. If dropping puts you below 12, you CANNOT drop it without a Reduced Course Load approval from the International Student Portal, or you will lose your visa status.

instruction: How do I look up classes for next semester without registering yet?
response: Navigate to the Registration card on Missouri State University portal and click Class Schedule Search to browse available courses, times, and professors.

instruction: Where do I accept my financial aid awards?
response: Navigate to the Financial Aid card on your student portal on Missouri State University portal, click Award Offer, review the details and accept or decline the funds.

instruction: How do I set up a payment profile for tuition?
response: Go to Account Balance & Payments on the Missouri State University portal, access the payment interface, and save your bank account or credit card details as a Payment Profile for future use.

instruction: I need to change my preferred name on the roster.
response: Navigate to My Student Records or Profile section on the Missouri State University portal and look for the option to update Preferred First Name.

instruction: How do I access my MSU email on my phone?
response: Download the Outlook app, select Add Account, enter your Missouri State University email address, and authenticate using your main university password.

instruction: Can I use Excel online without downloading it?
response: Yes, login to your Missouri State University email account via web browser, click the app launcher grid in the corner, and select Excel to use the web version.

instruction: What is the limitation of the student office license?
response: When you graduate or leave MSU, your license changes. You will lose access to the free desktop apps and OneDrive storage, so move your files before your account is deactivated.

instruction: How do I know if a class is full?
response: Use the Class Schedule Search on the Registration card of the Missouri State University portal. It will show the capacity and remaining seats (Rem) for each section.

instruction: How do I get on a waitlist for a class?
response: If a class is full and has a waitlist, try to add it via Add or Drop Classes on the Registration card. If available, select Waitlist from the dropdown action menu and submit.

instruction: I have an Advisor Hold, what does it mean?
response: It means you must meet with your academic advisor to discuss your schedule. Once you meet, they will remove the hold via their system so you can register.

instruction: How do I view my unofficial transcript?
response: Navigate to the My Student Records card on your student portal on Missouri State University portal and click the link for Unofficial Transcript to view your grades and history.

instruction: How do I order an official transcript?
response: Navigate to the My Student Records card on the Missouri State University portal and select Official Transcript Request. This usually redirects to a clearinghouse service where you pay and specify the recipient.

instruction: I need to apply for a program extension on my I-20.
response: Login to International Student Portal via Missouri State University portal, select Program Extension Request, you need financial documents and advisor recommendation explaining why you need more time, then submit before your current I-20 expires.

instruction: What should I do if I find an error in my SEVIS data?
response: Immediately contact the International Services office or use the 'Report a Data Error' function if available in the International Student Portal to correct name, birth country, or citizenship info.

instruction: How do I invite my parents for graduation (visa help)?
response: MSU does not issue invitation letters anymore. You should write a personal invitation letter yourself. Check the International Services website for a template to send to your family for their visa interview.

instruction: Can I work 40 hours during Spring Break?
response: Yes, F1 students can work more than 20 hours (up to 40) during official university holidays like Spring Break. Ensure you log hours correctly in the Employee Dashboard.

instruction: How do I access Canvas?
response: Click the Canvas card/icon on the missouri state university portal homepage, or go to the Learning Management System link to access your course materials.

instruction: How do I check my BearPass Card balance?
response: Navigate to the BearPass Card section on the missouri state university portal or the specific dining services card to see your meal plan and Boomer Meals balance.

instruction: I need to reset my MSU password.
response: Go to the Account Management page or click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen, or find the Password Change card in the portal if you are still logged in to update your credentials.

instruction: How do I print documents on campus?
response: Upload documents to the BearPrint system via the web or install the print driver, then go to any print station in the library or computer labs and swipe your BearPass card.

instruction: Where do I find the shuttle bus schedule?
response: Search for Bear Line Shuttle on the missouri state university portal or website, or download the transportation app to see live routes and schedules.

instruction: How do I register for a parking permit?
response: Navigate to the Parking & Transit card on the missouri state university portal, click My Parking Account, login, and select Purchase Permits.

instruction: I got a parking ticket, how do I pay?
response: Go to the Parking & Transit card on the msu portal, click My Parking Account, view your citations, and pay online.

instruction: How do I change my meal plan?
response: Navigate to the Housing & Dining card on the portal or contact the Residence Life/Dining Services office directly before the deadline for the semester to change your plan.

instruction: Where is the library database access?
response: Navigate to the Library card on the missouri state university portal to access Article Search, Databases, and the Catalog for your research.

instruction: How do I report a Title IX incident?
response: Search for the Office for Institutional Equity and Compliance on the msu portal or website, there is a 'Report an Incident' button for Title IX and discrimination issues.

instruction: How do I know my GPA?
response: Navigate to My Student Records card on the portal, click Unofficial Transcript or Grade Detail to see your cumulative and semester GPA.

instruction: I need to rent a laptop from the library.
response: Go to the main desk at Meyer Library. You can check availability via the Library card on the portal sometimes, but it is usually first-come, first-served.

instruction: How do I join a student organization?
response: Search for the Campus Link or Student Engagement card on the missouri state university portal to browse organizations and join them.

instruction: Can I work for two different departments on campus?
response: Yes, but your TOTAL combined hours cannot exceed 20 hours per week during the semester. You must coordinate with both supervisors and track hours carefully in the Employee Dashboard.

instruction: How do I sign up for emergency alerts?
response: Navigate to the Safety & Security card or Profile settings on the portal and look for Missouri State Alert preferences to add your phone number for text alerts.

instruction: Where do I find my advisor's email?
response: On the Registration Status page or My Student Records card, your advisor's name is usually hyperlinked to their email address.

instruction: I am an international student, can I take online classes?
response: Yes, but F1 regulations limit how many. Usually only one online class (3 credits) counts toward your 12-credit full-time requirement. Check with International Services via the portal if unsure.

instruction: How do I get a refund for my tuition overpayment?
response: If you have a credit balance, set up a Non-Payroll Direct Deposit in the Account Balance & Payments section on the portal to receive the refund faster than a paper check.

instruction: How do I book a study room in the library?
response: Navigate to the Library card on the missouri state university portal or the library website, look for Room Reservation, select a room and time, and confirm with your email.

instruction: What is the deadline to drop a class with a W?
response: Check the Academic Calendar link under the Registration card on the portal. It lists specific dates for 100% refund, no refund, and the final 'W' grade deadline.

instruction: How do I update my emergency contact?
response: Navigate to the Profile or Personal Information card on the missouri state university portal and edit the Emergency Contact section.

instruction: I need counseling services, where do I go?
response: You can contact the Counseling Center. Their info is often linked on the Magers Health card or Student Wellness card on the portal. You can schedule an appointment for mental health support.

instruction: How do I transfer out of MSU to another university?
response: If you are F1, you must apply for a Transfer Out request in the International Student Portal. You need the acceptance letter from the new school to release your SEVIS record.

instruction: Where can I see the courses required for my major?
response: Use Degree Works found in the Registration or Student Records card on the portal, or check the Undergraduate/Graduate Catalog link on the website.

instruction: How do I check my final grades?
response: Navigate to My Student Records card on the portal, click Final Grades, select the term, and view your results.

instruction: I have a hold for 'Accounts Receivable', what is that?
response: It usually means you owe money for tuition or fees. Go to Account Balance & Payments on the portal to pay the balance so the hold can be removed.

instruction: How do I access the Foster Recreation Center?
response: You use your BearPass card to enter. You can check hours and classes via the Campus Recreation card on the portal.

instruction: How do I find a job on campus?
response: Navigate to the Career Center card or search for Handshake on the Missouri State University portal, login, filter jobs by 'On-Campus', and apply.

instruction: I need to renew my visa stamp, do I need a new I-20?
response: Not necessarily a 'new' one, but you need a recent Travel Signature on your current I-20. Request this via the International Student Portal before you leave the US.

instruction: How do I get approved for a reduced course load in my final semester?
response: Login to the International Student Portal, select Reduced Course Load Request, choose 'Completion of Study' as the reason if you need fewer than 12 credits to graduate, and submit for advisor approval.

instruction: How do I check if my CPT was approved?
response: Check your email for notification or login to the International Student Portal and check the status of your F-1 CPT Request. Once approved, you will get a new I-20 showing the employer details.

instruction: Can I work on campus after I graduate?
response: No, your student employment eligibility ends the day you graduate. You must stop working immediately unless you have been hired into a full-time staff role with OPT or H1B sponsorship.

instruction: How do I submit my immunization records?
response: Upload them via the Magers Health and wellness center portal card on the msu portal, or mail/fax them to Magers Health Center.
